text: Rollback restores the previous model version after a failed release.
Readiness checks if the model is loaded and predictions can be served.
Airflow retries repeat failed tasks; publication must be idempotent.
A data hash links a model to a specific dataset snapshot.
Prometheus collects metrics and evaluates alert rules.
Grafana displays latency and errors from a Prometheus datasource.
Vault policies restrict which secrets an application can read.
Short lived tokens limit the lifetime of application credentials.
